title: Authenticate accepted source updates in historical reconciliation checks
body:
The aggregate historical reconciliation check rejected legitimate source updates, while the frozen clone and split-skip checks ran against optimized live helpers. This follow-up to #2026 replays those historical checks with their exact original inputs and recognizes only explicitly authenticated successor bytes.

- Preserve frontier890's original spectrum receipt by authenticating the exact one-digest refresh from Sagar Thakrar's `02c46c7e`. Bind the current helper hash and require every other byte, including all 41 mathematical cases.
- Authenticate batch932's exact assertion-safe runner/test successors (`2b7dc6cf`) and the scoped historical clone runner extension (`c58c1778`). Removing assertion protection, disabling the adapter, changing other bytes or forging predecessor pins still rejects.
- Reuse the authenticated isolated reconciliation92 replay from the aggregate checker. The original verifier and pre-PR154 Makefile pin remain unchanged.
- Restore PR53's exclusion-circuit helper from Wentao Li's retained baseline when replaying the original clone acceptance suite. Restore all three split-skip helpers named by its unchanged manifest: fused-block, exclusion-circuit and shared-point-circuit. Retain the live optimizations unchanged and reject any unrecognized live successor or corrupt baseline.
- Authenticate every replacement before copying and again before execution; keep all other tracked working bytes and the existing post-replay hash/diff gates. Reject duplicate paths and untracked dependencies. The default runner still executes every test module in its own interpreter; the historical clone module receives its authenticated original helper.
- Extend the existing scoped workflow's path filters and adapter controls, and run the same scoped job on contributor branches so fork CI can verify the repair.

Started from current main `e112d71c`. Current head `92276c22f6f419bbefd870bf2bb373bc41b0c643`. No historical coverage receipt, frozen archive, mathematical payload, selected-result record or contributor disposition is edited. No checks are disabled and no mathematical frontier is changed.

Validation on Windows / Python 3.11 with `PYTHONUTF8=1`:

- Complete `scripts/verify_pr_reconciliation.py`: PASS, 1,685 attributed PR records and all its full-tree inventories / evidence checks.
- Reconciliation regression suite: 38 tests pass normally and under `-O`.
- Historical replay adapter: 13 tests pass normally and under `-O`, including multiple dependency overlays, corrupt second inputs, duplicate/untracked dependencies, unchanged live sources and output mutation rejection.
- Isolated runner: 5 tests pass, including real child assertion failures under inherited optimization and same-named synthetic clone failures.
- Earlier spectrum replay: all 41 literal cases and package corruption controls pass; those source bytes are unchanged by the follow-up repairs.
- Exact baseline and successor hashes checked against the original manifests / Git objects; `git diff --check origin/main` passes.

Hosted Ubuntu checks on this exact head (`92276c22`) passed: **64/64 jobs across all eight fork workflows**, including all 52 full research matrix jobs (Python 3.11/3.13/3.14), the previously failing clone/test groups, historical Lean checks, R420 native checks, and the complete scoped source audit. Full matrix: https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38627449009 ; scoped audit: https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38627448547 . The registered-package selector against the actual PR base `e112d71c` emits an empty replay matrix.

**Remaining upstream queue:** all 65 CrocSwap-side PR checks still report QUEUED, with no runner assigned to the sampled scoped job. For example: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38627464190 . Earlier superseded-head checks also never started. The contributor account has read-only upstream repository permissions, so a maintainer needs to inspect/unblock that queue; no queued check is reported as passed, cancelled or bypassed. Requesting maintainer help with the queue, while the existing monitor continues following these runs.

Freshness checkpoint: canonical main fetched at `0fdd7d82`, priority revision 4, on 2026-10-14. Its new priority/discussion guidance was read; only guidance/catalogue files changed since this PR's pinned base and the selected record is unchanged. Continue the donor-assigned CI repair, without rerolling research or altering priority choices. This remains a CI/source integrity repair, not a new multiplication bound, selected cold replay or full theorem verification.

Credit ljste's spectrum audit; Sagar Thakrar's source-pin repair; woklerx's assertion-safety repair; Chafik Boukhalfa, RaD/hipotures and Rohan Garg's clone / split-skip lineage; Wentao Li's retained support-mask and shared-point digest baselines; and the historical reconciliation authors. Prepared by Dennis (`antunishdPursuit`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18930177
